jobs.title: Robot Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Why this role is exciting Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows. We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match. We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job. You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them. What you will own and deliver The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong. Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap. The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows. The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations. Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after. The scope This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it. What we are looking for PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted. You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall. You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists. Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim.. Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise. AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was. Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2. What success looks like in 90 days You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like. A

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading. These products move real money. You will lead that migration and the lifecycle programme built on top of it.</p> <p><strong>You will join a team of 6</strong> with a Growth Ops, a Growth Engineer, a Paid Acquisition Manager, a Senior GTM Engineer (hiring) and an Experimentation &amp; Tracking Engineer (hiring), and you will report to Julian, Team Lead Growth.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">This position is a permanent contract (CDI) based in Paris, hybrid.</span></p> <h3>💼 About the job</h3> <p><strong>Own the B2B lifecycle, from lead to active merchant</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and run the journeys that drive revenue: lead nurturing, onboarding, activating signed merchants who haven't taken a first payment, retention and win-back.</li> <li>Reach the right merchants at the right moment with the right message, using segments built on live data (industry, size, country, TPV, product usage).</li> <li>Run a yearly campaign calendar (seasonal moments, product launches, credit upsell) next to the always-on journeys, with clear pressure rules. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs. Contexte scientifique : La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029). Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données ( data centers ) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude. Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux — de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement — et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux — de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement. Au sein de la Chaire, le ou la post-doctorant(e) étudiera la manière dont les centres de données, objets clés de l’infrastructure numérique, se développent et organisent différents problèmes publics relatifs aux « territoires » à différentes échelles territoriales. Comment en retour, la définition et la hiérarchisation de ces problèmes peuvent permettent des arbitrages concertés pour planifier leur déploiement ? Les modalités de participation à la construction de ces problèmes publics, autant que la fabrique des données nécessaires pour nourrir les positions des acteurs, sont autant un enjeu de démocratie technique qu’une manière de retrouver prise sur l’aménagement des milieux de vie. En articulant sociologie des sciences et des techniques et études urbaines avec une méthodologie innovante de recherche-action , TerrAINs contribue à rendre visibles et discutables les infrastructures numériques, tout en expérimentant des outils de représentation des problèmes et de participation, adaptées aux enjeux infrastructurels contemporains. La Chaire est organisée selon trois axes principaux : Analyse des discours sur les centres de données, et notamment les discours médiatiques régionaux, nationaux et étrangers ; Description des modalités du « faire infrastructure » : pratiques situées, relations aux milieux, frictions. Cet axe investira trois sites franciliens concernés par des projets de centres hyperscale. la chaire est conçue comme un laboratoire de recherche-action qui expérimente de nouvelles modalités de représentation et de participation autour des infrastructures numériques. Vos missions principales seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le cadre de la Chaire Terrains Participer à l’animation de la chaire et contribuer aux projets menés par les autres membres de l’équipe Participer à des actions de valorisation des travaux menés au sein de la chaire Assurer des missions d’encadrement (stagiaires, workshops étudiant) Consulter la description des missions complètes dans la fiche de poste détaillée. Dans le cadre du projet ANR-DFG 3DFaceBias , qui vise à mesurer, expliquer et réduire les écarts de précision dans la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir de photographies 2D, nous recrutons un Post-doctorat en évaluation et réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D au sein de notre département Data Science sur le campus de Brest. jobs.title: People ops - M&A and International Expansion
jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. The M&A and International Expansion role Alan is diversifying its activities in the fields of healthcare, prevention and insurance through mergers and acquisitions, and is actively expanding internationally. In addition, Alan recruits talent worldwide and enables its employees to work remotely in complete safety. “Alaner, everywhere”. The role makes sure each acquisition and each country opening is legally secure, fast and humane: from HR due diligence, to transferring employment contracts, to fully integrating the people who join us. You'll join the Expansion crew inside the People team. You'll work closely with the crew owner, and with Corporate, Finance, team Leads and General Managers involved in each deal. The People team The People team is made up of 13 people who work in an environment shaped by Alan's Leadership Principles. Every one of them is a genuine fan of our products (Culture being one of them) and deeply committed to Alan's Prevention and Health mission. The team covers Learning and Development, Payroll and Admin, Employee Experience and Operational Efficiency, Compliance and Employment Law, Comp and Ben, and now M&A and International Expansion. It is a generalist team: everyone shares three core missions, namely People on-call (answering the day to day questions from Alaners, which is now AI-powered), individual situation management, and HRBP responsibilities. This represents roughly 50% of our time. Then each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour. In your case: M&A and expansion. Your missions On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will work on a very diverse range of high-impact topics: You will own to the People workstream of M&A transactions from due diligence to integration, alongside the crew and in close collaboration with the Corporate team, Legal, Finance and the business owners of each deal. Depending on the nature of the deal, you will own: HR due diligence: reviewing headcount, employment contracts, collective agreements, compensation & benefits, liabilities and risks of target companies, and flagging red flags clearly to the deal team; Transferring employment contracts in France and abroad, and choosing the right path for each deal and country; Integrating acquired teams: day-1 and first-months plans, harmonising contracts and benefits, communicating with acquired employees, onboarding them into Alan's way of working; You will support the people transition of acquired teams, working with the crew and leads on team set-up, keeping key talents, and supporting every individual situation with care; Working with external advisors (law firms, HR advisory, relocation and EoR providers): writing clear briefs and challenging their advice. Also: Opening new countries on the People side : entity vs employer of record, comp

jobs.title: Opticien (contrat freelance) 🇫🇷
jobs.description: 🐼 Qui est Alan ? En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé . L'optique est au cœur de la promesse d’Alan "La santé ne peut pas attendre". Avec l 'Alan Shop , nos membres achètent lunettes et lentilles de contact depuis l'application ; avec notre réseau d'opticiens partenaires , ils sont mieux remboursés en magasin ; et nos équipes Fraude veillent à ce que chaque euro remboursé le soit à bon escient. Nous avons prouvé qu'une assurance santé pouvait vendre de l'optique en ligne. Nous voulons maintenant passer à l'échelle, avec un·e opticien·ne supplémentaire dans l'équipe. 👓 Ce que nous recherchons Ce opticien·ne diplômé·e, à l'aise avec le conseil à distance et motivé·e pour rejoindre l'équipe d'opticiens prenant en charge les différentes missions autours de l'optique d'Alan Shop. Les missions : Chat optique. Répondre à nos membres sur l'application (choix de monture, lecture d'ordonnance, verres, lentilles, questions d'optique au sens large), avec le ton Alan : clair, bienveillant, personnalisé. Validation des commandes de lentilles de contact. Contrôler les ordonnances que notre outil automatique ne peut pas valider, et signaler les suspicions de fraude (dates modifiées, documents falsifiés) à notre équipe dédiée. « Mon Opticien au Travail ». Animer des journées de conseil et de vente sur site chez nos entreprises clientes, sur la France entière et en priorité en Île-de-France : accueil des salariés, conseil visagiste, prise de mesures, aide au choix de la monture. Amélioration continue. Partager vos retours terrain pour faire évoluer le service, et potentiellement être investi de potentielles missions additionnelles comme : contribuer à la montée en puissance de Mo, notre compagnon santé IA, sur les questions d'optique simples étoffer le catalogue de montures de l’Alan Shop en collaboration avec le Marketing pour créer les collections accompagner la mise à l’échelle et les mises à jour du réseau Alan Optique notamment sur les mises à jour des grilles tarifaires améliorer les journées “Mon Opticien au Travail” avec l’équipe commerciale pour maximiser la satisfaction, l’expérience et la conversion de ces évènements. ⭐️ Le profil Est-ce que vous vous reconnaissez ? ✅ Diplôme d'opticien·ne lunetier·ère (BTS Opticien Lunetier ou équivalent) — indispensable, avec numéro d'inscription à jour. ✅ Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en magasin , idéalement avec une forte dimension conseil et style (visagisme, colorimétrie : un vrai plus). ✅ Maîtrise des lentilles de contact et de la lecture d'ordonnances, y compris les cas complexes (toriques, multifocales). ✅ Basé·e à Paris ou en Île-de-France , disponible pour des journées sur site. ✅ Disponible sur des horaires flexibles, y compris le soir ou le weekend pour le chat, avec de la souplesse pour absorber des pics. ✅ À l'aise avec les outils digitaux ; curieux·se d'une pratique de l'optique en ligne et enthousiaste à l'idée d'intégrer l'IA dans son quotidien. ✅ Excellente expression écrite en français ; l'anglais est un plus. ✅ Statut indépendant (micro-entreprise ou société), ou prêt·e à le créer. 🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ? 💰 Des conditions claires. 25 € hors taxes de l'heure du lundi au samedi, 30 € hors taxes de l'heure le dimanche, facturés mensuellement. Les journées « Mon Opticien au Travail » sont rémunérées à la journée (de l'ordre de 500 à 750 € selon le format), frais de déplacement et d'hébergement pris en charge. 🕐 Une vraie flexibilité. Vous choisissez vos créneaux de chat en concertation avec l'équipe. 🤝 Une petite équipe d'opticiens avec qui échanger sur les cas complexes, et une interlocutrice unique côté Alan. 🚀 Un service en construction. Vous participez à la façon dont une assurance santé fait de l'optique en ligne et hors ligne : catalogue, parcours, nouveaux formats d'événemen

jobs.title: Legal Engineer, Tax & Audit
jobs.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. What you’ll be doing Let’s get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn’t fit neatly into a traditional box. It combines tax or audit expertise, product knowledge, client relationships and practical implementation. As a Legal Engineer in our Paris team, you’ll help tax and audit professionals put AI to work in their day-to-day practice. You’ll work with clients from the first demonstration through pilots, onboarding and wider adoption, understanding what they need and building workflows that hold up in real engagements. Some of what you’ll be doing: Understand the work. Work with tax partners, audit leaders and their teams to identify where Legora can make a meaningful difference, from tax research and advisory to evidence review and audit documentation. Build and test workflows. Translate client needs into working use cases, check outputs against source material and professional standards, and refine the approach with the people using it. Run demonstrations and training. Lead clear, practical sessions grounded in the client’s own work, adapting your approach for practitioners, partners and innovation teams. Own pilots and rollouts. Agree what success looks like, keep stakeholders and timelines aligned, and help teams move from initial experimentation to regular use. Support commercial conversations. Work alongside Go-to-Market and Customer Success colleagues to demonstrate value, address objections and identify opportunities to expand adoption across teams and service lines. Help improve the product. Bring client needs and product gaps back to Product and Engineering with clear examples and enough evidence to act on. Make good work reusable. Turn successful engagements into templates, guides and playbooks that colleagues and clients can use again. What you bring You come from tax, audit, assurance or a closely related advisory practice. You may have trained at a Big Four firm, worked at another professional services firm, or built your experience in an in-house function. Perhaps you’ve already moved into innovation, technology implementation or consulting. You understand the pressure of client deadlines, the importance of defensible conclusions and how much work sits behind a finished report or piece of advice. You also have ideas about how that work could be done better. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Have practical experience in tax or audit and can discuss the work credibly with experienced practitioners. You don’t need to be a specialist in both. Are genuinely curious about generative AI and enjoy learning new tools. You don’t need to be a software engineer or have held a Legal Engineering r

jobs.title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
jobs.description: 📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques. Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer . Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse , vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites. jobs.title: Responsable Réadaptation en Urgence
jobs.description: Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons un budget d'environ 255 millions d'euros, avec 4794 employés dans le monde.   Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. jobs.description: Was bluu bewegt Wir bei bluu verändern, wie Menschen ihren Haushalt machen. Unsere Produkte, zum Beispiel unsere Waschstreifen, machen Waschen und Putzen leichter. Warum funktioniert ein Creative diese Woche und nächste Woche nicht mehr? Und wie wird aus einem Like eine Bestellung, in der Schweiz und bald auch in Europa? Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. jobs.title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
jobs.description: Our common vision Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful. About the role Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions. Your responsibilities Monitor the automation and assure result quality Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness. Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects. Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis. Assure the quality of results over time Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests. Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks. Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team. Safeguard data and model quality Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality. Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early. Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams. Automate the operational workflow Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts. Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios. Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person. The impact you will have Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time. Issues are caught before customers see them, not after. The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated. Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand. Your experience and skills Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field. Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL. Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting. A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do. Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues. Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must. Bonus points Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization. Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics. Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools. Experience with Git, Doc

jobs.title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
jobs.description: The Challenge We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next. A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow. Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling. This is a remote opportunity. What You'll Do Own call quality holistically : hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments. Manage zones, codes, and origins : own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones. Update routing continuously : change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers. Work cross-functionally by design : partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users. Move routing toward automation : work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work. What You'll Bring Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience. NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD. Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus. Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts Who You Are Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix. Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it. A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team. Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked. Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach. jobs.title: Senior Acquisition Marketeer
jobs.description: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people across 190 countries. How they find us is changing fast: Search is moving from blue links to AI generated answers and paid and organic increasingly shape each other. A missed opportunity here isn't just a lower ROAS number. It's someone staying connected with family abroad, a business trying to reach a supplier, or someone who urgently needs to reach a real phone number. As our Senior Acquisition Marketeer, you won't own a channel. You'll own the outcome: Figuring out where Talk360's next valuable user is and the smartest way to reach them, across Google, Meta, TikTok, SEO, app stores, AI search, and whatever comes next. Think investment manager for acquisition, not channel specialist. Talk360 has been profitably growing since 2025. We're a lean team of around 30 people, with the majority of team working from the Amsterdam office. We're looking for someone genuinely channel agnostic: you don't wake up thinking about Google Ads or SEO; you wake up thinking about where the next valuable Talk360 user is. What you’ll do Own the acquisition portfolio: Continuously evaluate and reallocate investment across paid channels (Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, TikTok) and organic channels (SEO, ASO, content), based on where the next euro or hour of effort returns the most. Run segment-led acquisition: Adapt proposition, creative, keywords, landing pages, and app store presence for our three core segments, Calling Home, Calling for Work, and Calling When It Counts, and learn which segment performs best in which channel, market, and corridor. Connect acquisition to LTV: Track performance past the click or install, through registration, first purchase, calling behaviour, and retention, so decisions get made on CAC and LTV together, not platform ROAS alone. Build our AI discovery presence: Develop Talk360's approach to discovery as more of our future users start their search inside AI tools instead of Google. Run a continuous experimentation pipeline: Turn acquisition hypotheses (a new high-intent search category, a different proposition, an underserved corridor, a new distribution channel) into small, fast tests, and turn the results into investment decisions. The Team You’ll join a lean Commercial team where acquisition, brand, product marketing, CRM, content and data work closely together. No big silos or layers of approval: You’ll work directly with product, data and creative to turn an insight into a live experiment quickly. What you’ll bring Strong experience running paid acquisition on Google Ads, Meta, and/or Apple Search Ads, with real budget ownership and results to show for it. Working knowledge of SEO and ASO, and a track record of building organic acquisition that compounds rather than resetting every quarter. Fluency in CAC, ROAS, conversion, ARPU, and LTV, and the ability to build one framework that lets you compare channels that have never been compared before. Comfort moving between data, creative, content, and technology to shorten the distance between an idea and a live experiment. Active, current use of AI in your own marketing workflow, for research, analysis, content variation, and speeding up execution, not just openness to using it. Who you are Channel agnostic and opportunity driven, you're motivated by finding the next valuable user, not by defending a particular channel or discipline. Comfortable moving investment away from something that isn't working anymore, even if you're the one who built it. Genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping search and discovery and energised by figuring out a playbook that doesn't exist yet rather than waiting for one. Analytical: You can find the meaningful signal inside a pile of noisy performance data and act on it. Understand the limits of attribution and don't let an imperfect model stop you from making a call. You’re able to come to our office in Amsterdam on Mondays, Wednesday and Thursdays Recruitment process First

Dit is jouw uitdaging Bij het ramen van de kwartaalcijfers van het bbp (economische groei) gebruiken we voor een aantal bedrijfstakken momenteel een relatief eenvoudige methode: de ontwikkeling van het aantal banen dient als benadering voor de economische activiteit. Dit gebeurt omdat directe en tijdige broninformatie ontbreekt. Een belangrijk gevolg hiervan is dat we de eerste ramingen later vaak moeten bijstellen wanneer er meer volledige data beschikbaar komt bij de definitieve raming (ongeveer anderhalf jaar later). Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw opdracht is om te onderzoeken welke databronnen tijdig beschikbaar zijn en we kunnen gebruiken als input voor dit model. jobs.title: wo-stage statistiek: data-analyse en weegmethoden
jobs.description: wo- afstudeerstage, start in overleg Op zoek naar een statistiekstage? Analyseer bij het CBS weegmethoden en non-respons met R en draag bij aan betere statistieken voor Nederland. Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS trekt steekproeven onder de Nederlandse bevolking om diverse statistieken te maken. Hierbij is sprake van selectieve non-respons. Om voor deze non-respons te corrigeren, voeren we een zogenaamde weging uit, waarbij personen een gewicht krijgen op basis van hun onder- of oververtegenwoordiging in de respons. Personen met achtergrondkenmerken die ondervertegenwoordigd zijn in de respons, krijgen dan een groter gewicht dan personen met achtergrondkenmerken die oververtegenwoordigd zijn. Zie bijvoorbeeld [1] voor algemene informatie over wegen. Bij het uitvoeren van een weging zijn er diverse zaken om rekening mee te houden. Zo kan niet voor alle achtergrondkenmerken worden gecorrigeerd voor scheefheid, omdat de gewichten dan te extreem zouden worden. Daarnaast is het vaak verstandig om überhaupt niet voor te veel achtergrondkenmerken te corrigeren, omdat dit een negatieve invloed heeft op de marges van de schattingen voor de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek. Ook is er een relatie met de doelvariabelen in het onderzoek: op het moment dat er een samenhang is tussen een achtergrondkenmerk en de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek, is het wenselijk om wél voor dat achtergrondkenmerk te corrigeren als dat kenmerk scheef in de respons zit. Het is daarom vaak verstandig om toch zo veel mogelijk te corrigeren voor scheefheid in achtergrondkenmerken. Het CBS heeft een reguliere werkwijze voor het opstellen en uitvoeren van wegingen voor reguliere onderzoeken. Een optie die nog niet wordt gebruikt, maar wel interessant lijkt, is het uitvoeren van een zogenaamde voorweging. Hierbij wordt de weging min of meer in twee stappen uitgevoerd, waardoor er mogelijk voor meer en/of andere achtergrondkenmerken gecorrigeerd kan worden. Wellicht is het mogelijk om eerst een correctie uit te voeren voor non-respons en vervolgens een verdere weging uit te voeren die meer focust op de doelvariabelen van het onderzoek en de achtergrondkenmerken die daarmee correleren. Dit soort vragen speelt zowel bij de reguliere steekproeven die bij het CBS worden uitgevoerd als bij potentiële nieuwe toepassingen. In deze stage ga je aan de slag om verschillende opties voor de weging te analyseren, te kijken naar de verschillen tussen deze opties en te bepalen welke keuze de voorkeur heeft. Afhankelijk van de resultaten zouden weegmethoden aangepast kunnen worden, met directe impact op de statistieken van het CBS. [1] https://www.cbs.nl/nl-nl/onze-diensten/methoden/statistische-methoden/throughput/throughput/wegen-als-correctie-voor-non-respons   Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen Binnen het team waar je komt te werken, worden nagenoeg alle steekproeven voor het CBS getrokken. Hiermee staan we aan de kern van het waarneemproces en komen er allerlei statistieken langs bij het team. Daarnaast zijn we betrokken bij het maken van schattingen: hoe kunnen we de respondenten op zo’n manier mee laten tellen dat er zinnige resultaten uit onze onderzoeken komen die ook daadwerkelijk iets zeggen over de gehele populatie? We zijn een team met hoogopgeleide professionals die hoge kwaliteit nastreven. Als onze methoden verbeterd of uitgebreid kunnen worden, zodat we beter uit de voeten kunnen met de data die het CBS verzamelt, dan worden wij daar heel blij van. In deze stage ga je kijken of zulke mogelijkheden er zijn. Afhankelijk van de resultaten zullen we bestaande methoden opnieuw bekijken en kunnen onze methoden misschien worden toegepast op datasets waar dat nu (nog) niet mogelijk is. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een bèta-opleiding op wo-niveau met als studierichting statistiek. Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met: data-analyse; diverse onderzoeksmethoden en -technieken; programmeren in R; het rapporteren van bevindingen in een heldere en gestructureerde vorm. K

Omdat deze brieven steeds duurder worden, lijkt het voor de hand te liggen om geen herinneringen te sturen naar personen die nog niet gerespondeerd hebben, maar tegelijkertijd ook tot groepen behoren die al voldoende gerespondeerd hebben. In zekere zin zou dit ook een doelgroepgerichte benadering zijn. In deze stage ga jij aan de slag met een van de kernprocessen binnen het CBS: het trekken en uitbaten van de steekproef. Dit raakt de kern van onze processen: zonder data van goede kwaliteit kunnen we geen hoogwaardige statistieken maken. Jij gaat kijken naar de gevolgen voor onze statistieken van diverse keuzes die we bij het design kunnen maken. Zijn er verschuivingen in de samenstelling van de respons en zo ja, kunnen we begrijpen waarom die verschuivingen er zijn? En, misschien nog wel belangrijker, is er nog iets te merken van eventuele verschuivingen bij het maken van de statistieken? Wat gebeurt er als je bepaalde groepen weglaat uit de respons?  Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten is het wellicht handig en wenselijk om een soort doelgroepenbenadering in te voeren bij onderzoeken met alleen CAWI-waarneming. Gezien de stijgende kosten van het versturen van brieven, zou het zomaar kunnen dat we dit daadwerkelijk in gaan voeren. [1]  Doelgroepenbenadering (adaptief survey design) | CBS   Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen Binnen het team worden nagenoeg alle steekproeven voor het CBS getrokken. Hiermee staan we aan de kern van het waarneemproces en komen er allerlei statistieken langs bij het team. Daarnaast zijn we betrokken bij het maken van schattingen: hoe kunnen we de respondenten op zo’n manier mee laten tellen dat er zinnige resultaten uit onze onderzoeken komen die ook daadwerkelijk iets zeggen over de gehele populatie? We zijn een team met hoogopgeleide professionals die hoge kwaliteit nastreven. Als onze methoden verbeterd of uitgebreid kunnen worden zodat we beter uit de voeten kunnen met de data die het CBS verzamelt, dan worden wij daar heel blij van. In deze stage ga je kijken of zulke mogelijkheden er zijn. Afhankelijk van de resultaten zullen we bestaande methoden opnieuw bekijken. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een bèta-opleiding op wo-niveau met als studierichting statistiek. Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met: data-analyse; diverse onderzoeksmethoden en -technieken; programmeren in R; simulaties; het rapporteren van bevindingen in een heldere en gestructureerde vorm. Kernwoorden die jou omschrijven zijn proactief, analytisch, communicatief sterk en kritisch. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: jouw vakkennis vergroot en werkervaring opdoet met het doen van onderzoek en het analyseren van data; jouw communicatievaardigheden verder ontwikkelt en leert om onderzoeksresultaten

jobs.title: Teamleiter (m/w/d) Produktionscontrolling
jobs.description: Ihre neue Herausforderung als Teamleiter (m/w/d) Produktionscontrolling Sie kennen die Zahlen hinter einer Produktion und möchten künftig nicht nur analysieren, was passiert ist, sondern gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team mitgestalten, was als Nächstes kommt? Dann könnte diese Position gut zu Ihnen passen. Als erfahrene:r Produktionscontroller (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung für ein kleines, erfahrenes Team und bleiben gleichzeitig nah am operativen Tagesgeschäft. Ihr fachliches Know-how ist bei uns ebenso gefragt wie Ihre Fähigkeit, Aufgaben zu strukturieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und die unterschiedlichen Stärken im Team zusammenzubringen. Unser Produktionscontrolling ist eng mit den Abläufen unserer Produktionsstandorte verzahnt. SAP bildet dabei das Herzstück unserer täglichen Arbeit und die zentrale Datenbasis für Abrechnung, Kalkulation und Analyse. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team möchten wir unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und die Möglichkeiten von Digitalisierung und Automatisierung noch stärker nutzen. Sie schauen gemeinsam, wo neue Lösungen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen, Abläufe erleichtern und mehr Raum für die analytischen Aufgaben des Controllings ermöglichen. Folgende Aufgaben erwarten Sie an unserem Standort in Hamburg-Wilhelmsburg: Sie übernehmen die fachliche Führung und Weiterentwicklung unseres kleinen Teams im Produktionscontrolling, koordinieren Aufgaben und sorgen gemeinsam für verlässliche Abläufe im Tagesgeschäft. Sie verantworten die Abrechnung unserer Produktionsaufträge für die Abpackbetriebe der CAFEA-Gruppe, analysieren die Ergebnisse und arbeiten dabei eng mit unseren Produktionsstandorten zusammen. Sie behalten Herstellkosten, Bestände sowie die Auftrags- und Kostenstellenrechnung im Blick und stellen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen eine verlässliche Datenbasis in SAP sicher. Sie verantworten Kalkulationsläufe sowie relevante Sonderauswertungen und interne Kalkulationen und leiten aus den Ergebnissen die passenden Fragestellungen und Handlungsbedarfe ab. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team entwickeln Sie Prozesse, Auswertungen und unser Berichtswesen weiter und nutzen Digitalisierung und Automatisierung dort, wo sie die tägliche Arbeit sinnvoll unterstützen. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie Ihr Know-How in standortübergreifende CAFEA-Projekte ein und arbeiten mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Was Sie mitbringen Sie sind fachlich gerne mittendrin, können gleichzeitig den Überblick behalten und haben Freude daran, Menschen, Zahlen und Prozesse zusammenzubringen? Dann passen Sie möglicherweise ziemlich gut zu uns. Ob Ihr beruflicher Weg über ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium, eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung oder über mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung geführt hat, ist für uns dabei weniger entscheidend. Wichtig ist uns, dass Sie über fundierte Erfahrung im Controlling, idealerweise im Produktions- oder Werksumfeld, verfügen und betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge sicher beurteilen können. Sie haben bereits erste Verantwortung für andere übernommen, beispielsweise als fachliche Führungskraft, Stellvertretung, Projektleitung oder in einem kleinen Team? Perfekt. Sie müssen bei uns keine langjährige Führungskarriere mitbringen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass Sie gerne Verantwortung übernehmen, Orientierung geben, zuhören und Ihr Wissen mit anderen teilen. Unser Angebot Digitalisierung gemeinsam gestalten: Wir möchten die Möglichkeiten neuer Technologien künftig noch stärker für unser Produktionscontrolling nutzen. Dabei setzen wir auf Lösungen, die zu unseren Prozessen und vor allem zu den Menschen passen, die täglich mit ihnen arbeiten. Bei uns erwartet Sie nicht nur ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz, sondern auch eine langfristige Perspektive in einem international tätigen Familienunternehmen. Sie erhalten eine attraktive Vergütung, ergänzt durch Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld sowie regelmäßige Gehaltsanpassungen.

jobs.description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. jobs.title: (Senior) Customer Support Specialist (f/m/d)
jobs.description: UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen. Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerkerinnen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen. Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen. DEINE MISSION BEI UNS Als Customer Support Specialist (f/m/d) bist du verantwortlich dafür, unseren Kund:innen über alle Kanäle hinweg schnellen, präzisen und empathischen Support zu bieten. Du übernimmst ihre Fragen und Probleme vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Lösung, hilfst Handwerker:innen dabei, plancraft erfolgreich im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen, und bringst wertvolle Erkenntnisse aus dem Support ein, um unser Produkt und die Customer Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Du übernimmst den gesamten Lifecycle von Kundenanfragen über E-Mail, Chat und Telefon – von der ersten Einordnung und Analyse bis zur Lösung, Nachverfolgung und dem Abschluss. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Handwerker:innen bei Produktfragen, technischen Problemen und Fragen zu ihren Workflows. Du sorgst für schnelle und qualitativ hochwertige Lösungen, steuerst deinen Backlog eigenständig und behältst First Response und Resolution Times im Blick. Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für deine Fälle und arbeitest bei Bedarf eng mit Customer Success, Product und Engineering zusammen. Du dokumentierst und kategorisierst Fälle sauber und nachvollziehbar und lieferst damit wertvolle Informationen für Ursachenanalysen. Du erstellst und pflegst Help-Center-Artikel, Macros und interne Playbooks, um Self-Service-Angebote auszubauen und unseren Support skalierbarer zu machen. Du erkennst wiederkehrende Probleme, UX-Hürden und Wissenslücken frühzeitig und übersetzt diese Erkenntnisse in konkrete Vorschläge für Produkt- und Prozessverbesserungen. Du hilfst Kund:innen dabei, zentrale plancraft Workflows erfolgreich zu nutzen, löst Blocker und vermittelst Best Practices klar und praxisnah. Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung unserer Support-Automatisierungen und AI-Workflows durch Tests, Feedback und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Spezialisierungsthemen, beispielsweise als Feature Champion oder bei Onboarding Sessions und Webinaren. Du gehst Probleme strukturiert und analytisch an und findest pragmatische Lösungen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Kundenanliegen und treibst sie eigenständig bis zur Lösung. Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bringst eine bodenständige, kooperative Arbeitsweise mit. Du hast ein gutes technisches Verständnis und gehst sicher mit digitalen Tools und Software um. Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau. Nice-to-haves Du bringst erste Erfahrung im Customer Service, Customer Support oder Customer Success mit. Du hast Erfahrung mit Handwerksbetrieben oder kennst deren Arbeitsalltag und typische Workflows. Du hast bereits mit Tools wie Intercom, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace oder Stripe gearbeitet. Mit KI-Werkzeugen arbeitest du selbstverständlich. Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch gut. Was wir bieten 70.000 bis 85.000 € brutto im Jahr in Vollzeit. Wenn du lieber vier Tage arbeitest, geht das auch, mit anteiligem Gehalt. 100 % remote, Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Keine Produktionsarbeit: Gespräche, Urteil, Programme. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer und die Perspektive, den Partnerbereich zu verantworten. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Werkstudent:in Projektmanagement & Business Development
jobs.description: Kein klassischer Werkstudentenjob: Du baust mit uns ein neues Team auf, vom ersten Kundengespräch bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Dein Einstieg bei der msp AG Wir sind ein Hamburger Softwareunternehmen für Prozessberatung, Systemintegration und Entwicklung im Handel. Kunden wie REWE, EDEKA, hagebau, Vitra und die JAKO AG digitalisieren mit uns ihre Marketing- und Produktprozesse. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Händler und Marken ihre Produktdaten und Bilder im Griff haben: einmal sauber gepflegt, überall richtig ausgespielt, vom Onlineshop bis zum Prospekt. Dafür bauen wir in unserer MarTech-Abteilung gerade ein neues Team auf. Statt Aufgaben abzuarbeiten, die sonst liegen bleiben, arbeitest Du als vollwertiger Teil des Teams mit. Du denkst Lösungen mit, setzt sie selbst um und bist mit beim Kunden. Und Du begleitest den ganzen Prozess: Du bist dabei, wenn wir neue Kunden gewinnen, planst und setzt ihre Projekte mit um und betreust sie danach im laufenden Betrieb. Du lernst, was das Studium nicht beibringt: wie man Projekte führt, Kunden berät und Lösungen bis zum Ende trägt. Im Gegenzug bringst Du frische Ideen aus Uni und Studienumfeld mit. Darauf sind wir neugierig. Ganz ehrlich: Vieles in unserem neuen Team ist noch nicht fertig. Abläufe, Vorlagen und die Art, wie wir zusammenarbeiten, entstehen gerade. Wer hier einsteigt, legt selbst Hand an und gestaltet mit. Deine Aufgaben Projektsteuerung: Du planst und steuerst gemeinsam mit unserer Projektleitung Kundenprojekte und behältst Fortschritt, Aufwände und Termine im Blick. Umsetzung mit KI: Du setzt selbst im System um: Du konfigurierst Lösungen und baust Prototypen, KI-gestützt und wo nötig mit Code. Team mitaufbauen: Du hilfst, Vorlagen und Projektstrukturen für unser wachsendes Team aufzubauen. Anforderungen: Du arbeitest im Anforderungsmanagement mit: Anforderungen aufnehmen, dokumentieren und priorisieren. Datenkonzepte: Du wirkst an Datenkonzepten mit: welche Produktdaten unsere Kunden führen, wie sie strukturiert sind und wer sie pflegt. Kundentermine & Workshops: Du bereitest Kundentermine und Workshops vor und hältst Ergebnisse und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar fest. Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest mit unseren Teams aus Produktentwicklung, Vertrieb und Marketing zusammen. Das bringst Du mit Studium: Du studierst mit guten Noten, idealerweise im Master, gern mit IT- oder Wirtschaftsbezug wie Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen. Erste Praxiserfahrung aus Praktika, Jobs oder eigenen Projekten wäre von Vorteil. Lust auf KI: Du probierst neue KI-Tools aus, bevor jemand danach fragt, und willst herausfinden, wie man damit schneller und besser arbeitet. Selbst bauen: Du willst nicht nur verstehen, wie Systeme und Datenstrukturen zusammenspielen, sondern selbst Hand anlegen: konfigurieren, ausprobieren, auch mal Code schreiben und Deine Ergebnisse mit dem Kunden verproben. Erste Programmiererfahrung ist ein Plus. Anpacken: Dich reizt es, Dinge aufzubauen, die noch nicht fertig sind, statt Bestehendes zu verwalten. Offene Fragen motivieren Dich, statt Dich zu bremsen. Kundenkontakt: Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu und scheust kein Kundengespräch. Du drückst Dich klar aus, mündlich wie schriftlich, auf Deutsch und auf Englisch. Analytisches Denken: Du zerlegst komplexe Sachverhalte und erkennst, welche Frage zuerst zu klären ist. Du hast keine Angst, Datenstrukturen neu zu denken und zu gestalten. Verbindlichkeit: Zusagen und Termine hältst Du, und Du meldest früh, wenn etwas kippt. Das bieten wir Dir Verantwortung mit Rückendeckung: Du übernimmst als vollwertiges Teammitglied eigene Themen und Kundenaufgaben. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit Deiner Projektleitung zusammen und lernst direkt im laufenden Kundenprojekt. Das ganze Bild: Vertrieb, Projekt und Kundenbetreuung in einer Rolle, statt nur ein Ausschnitt in einer Abteilung. Echte Businesswelt: Neben dem Studium erlebst Du, wie Kundenprojekte wirklich laufen: mit echten Kunden, echten Budgets und echten Entscheidungen. Gest

jobs.title: Release Manager - AI Models
jobs.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Our engineering teams bring together ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to turn breakthrough autonomous-driving technology into reliable products. Model releases connect these disciplines, taking AI models from early hypotheses through training, evaluation, and on-road testing to deployment across our vehicle fleet. As our Release Manager — AI Models, you’ll help ensure that a core part of our technology — the AI model — is released reliably, on time, and to the standard required for production. You’ll bring structure and disciplined release practices to the fast-paced, non-deterministic world of ML, building the processes and systems that support clarity, stability, and business goals. 🧠 Your day-to-day Own the model release cycle, maintaining a steady and predictable cadence while adapting to changing business priorities. Coordinate across ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to keep releases moving and resolve dependencies. Run the gates that promote models from hypothesis → training → evaluation → validation → deployment, making clear what is ready to ship and what needs more work. Drive investigations into regressions and integration issues, coordinate rollback or roll-forward decisions, and follow through on technical debt and corrective actions. Be the central point of contact for model-release status, risks, and timelines, giving engineers and leadership the right level of detail. Run post-release reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements across teams. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Release gates and promotion criteria: Define and justify what it takes for a model to progress, balancing performance gains, reproducibility, product requirements, safety, and compatibility with the onboard software stack and vehicle platform. A release process that works for ML: Build frameworks that connect model development, evaluation, the Wayve onboard stack, and product needs — applying strong release-engineering practices while recognising where hypothesis-driven, non-deterministic systems need a different approach. Bottleneck identification and improvement: Find constraints in the release lifecycle, implement dashboards and KPIs to make them visible, and proactively escalate gaps. Tooling and automation: Partner with ML platform and integration teams to shape end-to-end automated release tooling. Define requirements that improve developer experience, release efficiency, and stakeholder communication. Reliable, stable deployments: Strengthen how teams handle model versions, integration issues, regressions, and recovery so that releases deliver value reliably. 🙌 You should apply if: You have 5+ years of experience in release management, software engineering, or a related field. You understand the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and release management practices, including testing strategy, system integration, branching, and versioning. You have a conceptual understanding of ML fundamentals: what training data is, the difference between training and inference, what a model version or checkpoint represents, and why model validation is probabilistic rather than simply pass/fail. You have experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools such as GitHub, Buildkite, and CLI tools. You’re skilled at managing releases in complex, fast-moving systems and comfortable adapting processes and tooling as requirements, architecture, and timelines change. Our goal: the data we return to clients is always correct, and we find defects before a client does. Design processes for safe updates to security entries, with validation and rollback. jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products. Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why. Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest: Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant. You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them. You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now. You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions. You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own. You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all). You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! jobs.description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Expose manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s advanced circuit boards with tests you build and deploy.</p> <p>Based in Bristol, UK, you’ll develop board and PCBA hardware tests that help turn complex designs into reliable products. You’ll take tests from initial design analysis to deployment, then support them in factories and the field.</p> <p>Better defect coverage means more opportunities to identify manufacturing problems and understand hardware failures when products are in use. You’ll help make test and inspection methods work together, targeting the ways advanced electronic assemblies can go wrong.</p> <p>You’ll examine PCB testability and susceptibility to manufacturing defects, then use that analysis to define and develop test solutions. You’ll build boundary scan and embedded functional tests, turning your understanding of board behaviour into practical diagnostic tools.</p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>The Product Test and Diagnosis team tackles hardware defects across chips, boards and finished systems. You’ll work directly with Hardware Design, Manufacturing Operations and contract electronics manufacturers, connecting design knowledge with factory experience.</p> <p>Use evidence to guide test decisions, challenge gaps in coverage and take responsibility for moving improvements forward. Move quickly from diagnosis to action, bringing the right people together to resolve hardware problems.</p> <h2>What we're looking for</h2> <ul> <li>Strong electronics fundamentals, particularly digital electronics.</li> <li>Commercial experience in board or PCBA hardware testing.</li> <li>Understanding of manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems.</li> <li>Knowledge of surface-mount technology (SMT), PCB manufacturing processes and their failure mechanisms.</li> <li>Understanding of automated optical inspection (AOI) and automated X-ray inspection (AXI) capabilities.</li> <li>Ability to diagnose electronic defects to component level.</li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. jobs.title: Co-Founder & CTO (gn), Industrial Data for AI, Paris
jobs.description: About FoodLabs FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. About The General Data Corporation General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. Why this is a unique opportunity AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up. About the role Supplier intake: Build connectors for where companies actually keep their data: Databases, document stores, ticketing systems, machine logs, and sensor and video archives.  Transaction layer: Own the pipeline, rights evidence, contracts, permissions, audit trail and delivery API. ML and data quality: Build anonymisation across text, tables, images and video, plus re-identification checks, deduplication, quality scoring and tooling that turns raw records into training-ready data.  Delivery and compute: Decide whether data is processed in our cloud or inside the supplier’s environment. Build secure delivery, recurring updates and our GPU infrastructure. Technical direction: Own the architecture and roadmap. jobs.title: Junior Business Data Analyst
jobs.description: PIX4D is seeking a talented Business Data Analyst to bridge Finance, Product Management and Commercial Operations (Sales and Marketing), develop complex analytical tools to drive strategic decisions and optimize processes. You will be a member of PIX4D’s dynamic Finance team, in a hybrid work environment, based in Lausanne, Switzerland. In this cross-functional role, you will query complex datasets, build dashboards, define KPIs, and translate emerging trends into actionable insights for stakeholders. You will balance data integrity with commercial impact, transforming raw data into insights that support high-level strategic decisions. Responsibilities Data Analysis & Reporting: Cleaning, manipulating, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies. Dashboard Development: Creating interactive dashboards and reports using dashboarding tools and leveraging AI-powered tools for enhanced automation and visualization. AI & Automation: Leveraging Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to streamline data workflows and enhance intelligent decision-making. Database Querying: Using SQL to extract and prepare data from various systems. Actionable Insights: Translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for business growth, efficiency, and optimization. Stakeholder Collaboration: Working with cross-functional teams to define business requirements and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Data Governance: Ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and standardization. Requirements Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Excel (advanced), and experience using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker). AI Proficiency: Familiarity with Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations. Analytical Abilities: Strong statistical knowledge, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. Communication: Ability to tell a story with data to non-technical stakeholders. Education/Experience: A master’s degree in business, economics, statistics, or data analytics, coupled with a first experience in supporting data-driven decisions. What we offer Exciting work with cutting-edge technology in an international company. Well-located office near Lausanne, with easy access by public transport. Flexible working hours and hybrid work possibility. 25 days of paid vacation. Employee Assistance Program with Lyra providing Mental, Legal and Financial assistance. Contribution to some events: Bike to Work (the biggest health and cycling promotion campaign in Switzerland), Lausanne Triathlon. Discounts for local stores, restaurants and other services. Company Social Events. Learning and professional development opportunities. Working environment PIX4D is a unique, fun, and intellectually stimulating company where you can grow and excel in your field. Our environment is authentic and multicultural, a place where we respect and learn from each other in the pursuit of being the best at what we do. Get more information here . Recruitment PIX4D promotes diversity and offers opportunities across all levels and career paths in all of its offices regardless of gender, race, or religion. We use standardized and structured interviews to ensure all candidates are treated equally and avoid any discrimination. Company When you work at PIX4D, you empower professionals worldwide to digitize reality through survey-grade georeferenced 2D maps and 3D models. These outputs can be measured, analyzed, and shared, all based on data from images taken by plane, drone, or mobile phone. We build solutions that take advantage of technology including reality capture, computer vision, digital twins, and machine learning to help solve our customers' most complex challenges. Founded in 2011, PIX4D has its headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland and commercial and R&D offices in Denver, Berlin, Tokyo, Bucharest and Madrid. Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations. What you’ll do Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability. Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers. Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them. Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers. Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up. What you'll bring Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user. NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0. A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching. Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us. A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role. Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region. Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD. Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor. Hiervoor werken we uitsluitend met hoogwaardige en betrouwbare kwaliteitssystemen en lopen we graag voorop als het gaat om technologische ontwikkelingen. Ben jij de ervaren Hybrid Cloud Consultant die ons team aanvult? Wat hebben wij jou als  nieuwe collega te bieden? Goed salaris, passend bij opleiding en werkervaring Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden Uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden Mogelijkheid om door te groeien Een afwisselende en uitdagende functie in een prettige, informele werkomgeving Wat  ga je doen? Opstellen van uitgebreide technische ontwerpen voor hybride Cloud omgevingen; Adviseren op tactisch en strategisch niveau; Beoordelen van klantlandschappen, risico’s en afhankelijkheden en deze vertalen naar robuuste oplossingen; Zelfstandig uitvoeren én technisch aansturen van complexe implementaties; Inrichten van end to end hybride infrastructuren, inclusief hardwarevoorbereiding, migraties en geavanceerde configuraties; Coördineren van technische werkzaamheden binnen het projectteam en fungeren als primaire technische autoriteit; Realiseren van veilige en schaalbare integraties tussen on prem en Cloud omgevingen; Fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt op alle niveaus, van beheerder tot directie; Bewaken van scope, kwaliteit, documentatie en naleving van beveiligings- en changeprocedures; Signaleren van risico’s, afwijkingen en meerwerk; Opstellen en toelichten van hoogwaardige technische documentatie, overdrachtsrapporten en implementatieverslagen; Voeren van complexe technische en tactische klantgesprekken; Ondersteunen van Sales en Pre sales bij inhoudelijke vraagstukken; Coachen van Junior en Medior Consultants; Actief bijdragen aan kennisartikelen, standaardisatie en best practices; Meedenken over verbetering van processen, tooling en kwaliteit binnen het team. VDK Installatiegroep, de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland!
