jobs.title: Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering
jobs.description: Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering Voor deze rol zijn wij op zoek naar een Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering die techniek, analyse en implementatie moeiteloos combineert. Jij krijgt energie van het ontwikkelen, programmeren en inbedrijfstellen van software voor gebouwbeheersystemen. Met jouw kennis van regeltechniek zorg je ervoor dat installaties juist functioneren én voldoen aan de wensen van de klant. Wat bieden wij jou? Als Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering kom je terecht in een fijne en professionele werkomgeving met betrokken collega’s, waar samenwerking en werkplezier vooropstaan. Daarnaast bieden wij jou: • Een zelfstandige en afwisselende functie waarin je softwareontwikkeling, inbedrijfstelling en klantcontact combineert; • Werken binnen een professionele organisatie met korte communicatielijnen en een sterke focus op vakmanschap; • Ruimte en mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen jouw vakgebied; • Opleidingen en cursussen, volledig verzorgd door V en M Regeltechniek; • Een werkomgeving waarin jouw technische expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je langdurige klantrelaties kunt opbouwen; • Een prima salaris op basis van kennis en ervaring; • 25 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen (bij een fulltime werkweek); • Een goede pensioenregeling. Wat ga je doen? Als Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering bij V&M Regeltechniek ben je samen met je collega’s verantwoordelijk voor de software van onze regeltechnische systemen. Je ontwikkelt, test en implementeert programmeeroplossingen en brengt deze in bedrijf bij de klant. Je vertaalt regeltechnische omschrijvingen naar software- en besturingsprogramma’s, test deze uitvoerig en zorgt dat ze voldoen aan de functionele eisen. Je bent betrokken bij zowel de ontwikkeling als de inbedrijfstelling en levert service, op afstand én op locatie. jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Fundingo is a loan servicing platform built natively on Salesforce. Our customers are lenders and loan servicers who use Fundingo to run their day-to-day operations. Our delivery team works directly with those customers, building custom implementations, integrations, and data migrations that fit Fundingo to how each customer runs their business. As a Salesforce Technical Lead, you'll set the technical direction for our delivery projects. You'll make the architecture decisions, own our Git-based development process and code standards, review the team's code, and direct the work of the Salesforce developers on each project. You'll also take part in internal strategy discussions and join sales conversations with prospective clients who need integration expertise. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, with development in Apex and Lightning Web Components as the primary focus. You’ll also lead technical design, review code, and guide developers on assigned delivery projects. The balance will vary based on project complexity and team needs. You'll direct the developers' work on your projects, but this isn't a people-management role: developers don't report to you, and you won't handle things like time-off requests. It is also not an admin or configuration role. WHAT YOU’LL DO Architecture and technical direction Own the technical design for delivery projects, including automation, integration patterns, and how custom work extends Fundingo without fighting it. Document and communicate these designs so the team and the customer can understand them. Choose the right tool for each requirement, whether that's Apex, Flow, Lightning Web Components, or configuration, and know when not to write code. Weigh speed, scalability, and maintainability against each other, and communicate these considerations to the team. Design integrations with outside systems like payment processors, accounting systems, and document providers that are reliable and easy to support. Development process and code quality Own the Git-based development workflow for delivery projects, including branching, pull requests, merge rules, and deployment practices, aligned with Fundingo’s company-wide engineering standards. Use and enforce our company's coding standards, naming conventions, and design patterns, and make sure the implementation team follows them. Review pull requests for correctness, security, performance, test quality, and fit with the design. Your feedback should help developers grow, not just get their code merged. Team leadership and communication Lead the developers' work on each project by assigning and sequencing tasks, pairing with them, unblocking them, and helping them improve their design and debugging skills. Work with the Implementation Specialists and Business Analysts to break customer requirements into well-scoped work, and help project managers estimate, plan, and sequence it. Raise the technical skill level of Fundingo’s developers and Salesforce admins through code reviews, pairing, best-practice guidance, and knowledge sharing. Lead technical discovery and design sessions with customers. Turn business requirements into technical designs, and explain constraints, options, and tradeoffs in plain language. Act as the technical point of contact for customers' IT teams and outside vendors on integrations, data migrations, and escalations. Support sales and leadership by joining conversations with prospective clients about integrations and complex requirements, and by bringing a technical perspective to internal strategy discussions. Hands-on development and delivery Build scalable and performant implementations using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce tools. Plan and oversee data migrations from legacy systems, including mapping, transformation, validation, and cutover. Lead troubleshooting of production issues in customer orgs using debug logs and customer reports. Support technical go-live readiness, inc

jobs.description: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70 K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more. At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place! Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients. Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest! Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team. The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun! We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include: Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year. 401K with maximum employee matching. Health care benefits. Generous paid vacation and sick leave time. Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation. Full administrative support. Here are a few extra perks our team loves: Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time. Customized schedules within available clinic hours. Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations). Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment. Incredible administrative support team. Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare. Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership. We are not a franchise

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. About the role Oura is rebuilding how it builds software. Every engineer has agentic tooling, and our own pipeline already takes a well-formed ticket to a reviewed, tested commit stack. It runs interactively, headless, and on a cloud sandbox fleet, with its own evals and tracing. We are looking for engineers who use AI as a fundamental building block of both the products we ship and the way we build them. That is a strong start on one stage of the lifecycle. The next step is the whole loop. As a Staff Engineer on the AI Transformation team, you will architect and own the system that turns agentic development from something power users do into the way hundreds of engineers across iOS, Android, backend and AI services ship every day. That means spec and intake, planning, implementation, review, testing, CI/CD, release, observability and incident follow-up, each with agents doing real work and humans keeping judgment where it matters. This is a fast-moving, LLM-forward team. We prioritize rapid prototyping, iterative loops and AI-native development, with the speed of a startup and the reach of a product used by millions of members. You can work remotely from anywhere in Europe, or hybrid from our offices in Helsinki, Oulu or Tampere. You will build the pipeline, measure it, and make it trustworthy enough that teams choose it. Success is measured in validated changes reaching members faster and safer: time to a trustworthy signal, escaped defects, cost per merged change, and how many squads run on the paved path because it is better, not because they were told to. What you will do You don't need to do all of these on day one, but these are the kinds of problems you'll own: Set the technical direction for the agentic pipeline: Make our existing ticket-to-PR pipeline dependable infrastructure. Own its architecture, including agent orchestration, context management and tool calling, and improve its reliability, throughput, cost and developer experience across mobile, backend and web repositories. Run it unattended where the risk allows. Close the loop across the SDLC: Extend agentic workflows beyond code generation into spec quality checks, test generation, automated review, CI failure triage and repair, release verification, and post-deploy signals, so the system improves from what happens after merge. Prototype fast, then harden: Get a new workflow running in days, prove it on real tickets with real squads, and turn what holds up into production infrastructure. Run AI in production properly: Agents in production take more than an API call. Own the eval sets, LLM-as-a-judge grading, versioning, tracing and dashboards that tell us whether a workflow change made things better, including the hardest case: a change that passes CI and is still wrong. Track the numbers that matter (merge rate, rework, time-to-signal, cost per change, escaped defects) and make them visible to engineers and leadership. Make autonomy safe: Design sandboxing, permissions, human checkpoints and guardrails proportional to risk, with privacy by design as the default. Health data, security and infrastructure changes get stronger controls; low-risk, easily verified work runs hands-off. Lead AI-native engineering by example: Set the bar for AI-augmented engineering across the organization. Show in your own wo
